description.zh:
创建高可用VIP的数量。取值范围：1~10，当指定IP地址创建时，数量只能为1。

默认值：1
description.en:
The number of HAVIPs that you want to create. Valid values: 1 to 10. The value can be only 1 if you specify an IP address.

Default value: 1.
The IP address of the HAVIP.
The vSwitch ID of the HAVIP.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-ha-vip --description testDescription --name yourName --vswitch-id vsw-50000 --ip-address 120.24.243.91 --amount 6 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens CreateHaVip --region cn-hangzhou --Description testDescription --VSwitchId 'vsw-50000' --Amount 6 --IpAddress '120.24.243.91' --Name yourName
